name: save-boot-5-party-barret-battle
description: #101: party slot 1's current HP is the value a battle lowers. Boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-barret.json (party Cloud, Barret, empty). Load as save-boot-1-load does: from the title, Circle every 30 frames until field mode, then #77's field-loaded rule; the field is md1stin (116). Hold Up+Left (59 of every 60 frames) until g_GameState reads battle (2; battle_wait): up-left leaves md1stin for md1_1 (#77), where #78's attempt 3 met a random battle. 600 frames for the battle to start, then at the mark: partyID[1] reads Barret (0x01) and its current HP is in 1..9999 (hp1_ok). Then 2400 frames with no input (the enemies attack; nobody acts): g_ActiveCharacters[1].hp decreases since the mark (hp1_dir -1) while max HP is unchanged (max1_dir 0), and the battle is still on. act_id1: the raw byte at g_ActiveCharacters[1] + 0 at the end (attempt 1: not the character ID). Signs, 1/0 and that byte only; no HP leaves. map_cur: the field the battle started from. match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state.
